plausible_mechanisms_not_live_proven: Layout similarity measures occupied tile crop/animal matching and land equality. It is a policy-family cue, not a causal predictor of fertilizer profitability or rival selling times; different unlocked quadrants forces similarity0.

Forecast uses native own tape to predict extra harvest and current market price for eventual added wheat/carrot revenue. It accounts for added own quantity when quoting the value, but does not explicitly simulate future rival supply, later demand or sale timing.

The lower gate accepts smaller estimated safety margins, so forecast or market-reaction errors can turn a locally positive project negative; this is a candidate explanation, not a confirmed cause of live score difference.
The aggressive flag stays frozen although rivals can diverge after day11. Later spot checks still prevent many bad tours, but do not reclassify the rival.
Extra tomato workers/inputs can improve realized yields yet cost wages and cash or shift sale timing. No live replay counterfactual has isolated which of the three combined changes helps or hurts.
